title: Satín Greco wins España Season 5
summary: In the Grand Finale (ES-S05-E11), Margarita Kalifata and Satín Greco lip-synced to Rocío Jurado's "Déjala correr". Satín Greco won €50,000 and the crown.

title: Two-pieced Heart save twist
summary: Season 5 introduced the Two-pieced Heart: eliminated queens gifted heart halves that could save a contestant from the bottom. The mechanic was used across several weeks including saves for Ferrxn, Nix, and Laca Udilla.

title: Nori: Season 5 Porkchop and Miss Congeniality
summary: Nori was the first contestant eliminated on España Season 5 (ES-S05-E02) and was later voted Miss Congeniality.
